purpose: Record which optimiser actually trained the Phase 2 detector and segmenter.

sources.training_code: src/spv/detect.py and src/spv/segment.py call model.train(...) without an optimizer argument, so the Ultralytics default optimizer='auto' applies.
sources.ultralytics_rule: BaseTrainer.build_optimizer: with optimizer='auto', lr_fit = round(0.002*5/(4+nc), 6); AdamW(lr_fit, momentum 0.9) when iterations <= 10000; iterations = ceil(n_train / max(batch, nbs)) * epochs.
sources.checkpoint_train_args: Team evidence training_provenance_from_checkpoints.json (read from the released checkpoints, Ultralytics 8.4.182, detector sha256 f48e4d8e..., segmenter sha256 868f3842...): optimizer 'AdamW', lr0 0.001667, lrf 0.01, warmup_epochs 3, momentum 0.937. In auto mode Ultralytics writes the chosen optimizer and lr0 back to the arguments but builds AdamW with betas (0.9, 0.999); the saved momentum 0.937 is the unused default.

superseded_statement: Earlier report drafts stated 'SGD (auto), lr0 0.01'; contradicted by all sources above.
